title: Just Tweaks
description: A Minecraft Mod that just tweaks some stuff and adds must-have features to the game, while keeping it super vanilla-friendly.
body:
# Just Tweaks

A lightweight, quality-of-life Minecraft mod that adds small but useful tweaks to improve your gameplay experience. Works on Fabric, Forge, and NeoForze.

## Features

### 🔧 General Tweaks
- **Right-Click Harvest** — Right-click fully-grown crops to harvest and auto-replant. Works with all vanilla crops.
- **Auto-Replant** — Seeds are automatically replanted from your inventory or the crop's own drop.
- **Double Doors** — Interacting with one door in a double-door pair opens/closes both.
- **Durability Warning** — Flashes the screen red and plays a sound when your tool reaches critical durability.
- **All Recipes Unlocked** — All recipes are automatically granted on login. No more waiting for the recipe book!

### 🌲 Tree & Mining
- **Fast Leaf Decay** — Leaves decay instantly after all logs are removed. No more waiting around.
- **Full Tree Mining** — Hold the keybind while breaking a tree to automatically mine all connected logs and clear the leaves. Configurable cascade speed.
- **Vein Mining** — Hold the keybind while mining ores, sand, gravel, or clay to mine the entire vein at once. Ores are unlimited (up to 200 blocks), soft blocks are instant (up to 32 blocks).

### 🚂 Minecarts
- **Chained Minecarts** — Minecarts can link together! Use a lead on a minecart to link it to another. Linked minecarts follow their leader with smooth physics-based pulling.

### 🕯️ Lighting
- **Glow Torch** — A waterproof torch that waterlogs instead of breaking underwater. Crafted just like a regular torch but with a glowstone block.
- **Light Source Slot** — A dedicated curio/trinkets slot for light-emitting items. Dynamic lighting activates when holding a light source in the slot.

### 🌊 Items
- **Air Bottle** — Right-click underwater to fill a bottle with air. Right-click in air to empty it and place a water source. Great for underwater building!

### 🛡️ Other
- **Campfire Healing** — Standing near a lit campfire slowly heals you.
- **Armor Stand Pose** — Sneak + right-click an armor stand to cycle through poses.
- **Vehicle Pickup** — Sneak + right-click a minecart or boat to pick it up as an item.
- **Ender Pearl Cactus Protection** — Prevents ender pearls from being destroyed by cactus.
- **Farmland Trample Protection** — Prevents farmland from being trampled by entities.
- **Copper/Diamond/Gold/Iron/Netherite Horse Armor** — Craft all missing horse armor variants.
